summary: CAIR Action, whose recommendations weigh Gaza and ceasefire positions, endorsed Yvonne Martinez Beltran in the general phase of her Morgan Hill council race. The CAIR-SFBA tracker additionally records her as having supported a local peace resolution in March 2024, though it qualifies that entry as a reported local action rather than a verified roll-call transcript.
